w5-a-eced2a17.en: Dance with me! Left step, right step!

w5-a-8510a5f3.en: Let’s find some grass to lie on!

w5-a-6cd852ed.en: Look, the clouds are drifting by.

w5-a-99e0b8ac.zh: 金圈在后面，我们掉个头～
w5-a-99e0b8ac.en: The rings are behind us. Let’s turn round!

w5-a-bc627036.zh: 点「起飞」，穿过金圈拿金币！
w5-a-bc627036.en: Tap Take off, then fly through the rings for coins!

w5-a-4942658f.zh: 按 G 起飞，穿过金圈拿金币！
w5-a-4942658f.en: Press G to take off, then fly through the rings for coins!

w5-a-6fc05e0d.zh: 漂亮！下一个金圈在前面～
w5-a-6fc05e0d.en: Nice! The next ring is up ahead.

w5-a-24fec38d.zh: 点一下你自己，可以挥手、跳舞、和我自拍！
w5-a-24fec38d.en: Tap yourself to wave, dance or take a selfie with me!

w5-a-68298c99.zh: 按 T 可以挥手、跳舞、和我自拍！
w5-a-68298c99.en: Press T to wave, dance or take a selfie with me!

w5-a-091146f2.zh: 海獭前臂下有小口袋，我也有哦！
w5-a-091146f2.en: Sea otters have pockets under their arms. Me too!

w5-a-bfa0e810.en: Okay, okay, my fur is all messy now!

w5-a-41337b02.zh: 海獭亲戚也这样仰面漂，肚子当桌子！
w5-a-41337b02.en: My sea-otter cousins float like this, chest as a table!

w5-a-b17956bd.en: Over here! Come closer for a pat.

w5-a-db8fd262.zh: 真美……这张风景记进手帐啦！
w5-a-db8fd262.en: So pretty… that view goes in the notebook!

w5-n-74e4356b.zh: 这里暂时过不去，换个地方试试？
w5-n-74e4356b.en: Can't get there right now — somewhere else?

w5-d-5d4d841f.zh: 今天的饼干拿过啦，明天可能不一样哦。
w5-d-5d4d841f.en: You had today’s cookie — tomorrow’s may be different.

w5-d-c3f12f7d.zh: 六七月大多数海狮南下生宝宝，所以浮台空了一些。
w5-d-c3f12f7d.en: In June and July most of them head south to have pups — the docks look emptier.

w5-d-fe2ba335.zh: 夏天过后，海狮通常会陆续回到浮台上来。
w5-d-fe2ba335.en: After the summer they usually drift back to the docks.

w5-d-421228f2.zh: 这个季节，浮台上通常很热闹——听听它们在聊什么！
w5-d-421228f2.en: This time of year the docks are usually busy — listen to them chat!

realsf-fire-season-end.zh: 海滩篝火季到 10 月底，11 月起就不能生火啦。
realsf-fire-season-end.en: Beach-fire season ends with October — no fires from November.

w5-d-064b2e94.zh: 看！红脸蛋的小绿鹦鹉！2023 年它们成了旧金山的官方动物。
w5-d-064b2e94.en: Look — red-faced green parrots! In 2023 they became San Francisco’s official animal.

w5-d-ce93df5c.zh: 它们是野生的，看看就好，别喂哦。
w5-d-ce93df5c.en: They’re wild — just watch, no feeding.

w5-d-2b371f53.zh: 听说电报山台阶的花园里，早上常有一群吵吵闹闹的绿鹦鹉。
w5-d-2b371f53.en: They say a noisy green flock visits the Telegraph Hill stair gardens in the mornings.

w5-d-6f8ba0b8.zh: 1989 年大地震后，海狮就搬到这片浮台上来了。
w5-d-6f8ba0b8.en: The sea lions moved onto these docks after the 1989 earthquake.

w5-d-e73dd178.zh: 看就好，别喂——喂海狮是违法的哦。
w5-d-e73dd178.en: Just watch — feeding them is against the law.

w5-d-c8657c88.zh: 听说 39 号码头的海狮，每个季节来的数量都不一样。
w5-d-c8657c88.en: They say the PIER 39 sea lions come and go with the seasons.

w5-d-805044c1.zh: 海边乐园 1972 年关门后，这家游戏厅买下了一位"大笑女士"。
w5-d-805044c1.en: When the beach amusement park closed in 1972, this arcade bought a “laughing lady”.

w5-d-b8cae28c.zh: 哈哈……她一笑，我也忍不住了！
w5-d-b8cae28c.en: Ha ha… when she laughs, I can’t help it either!

w5-d-9c5ab8fe.zh: 听说 45 号码头那家老游戏厅门口，总能听见有人哈哈大笑。
w5-d-9c5ab8fe.en: They say you can hear someone laughing at the old arcade on Pier 45.

w5-d-87e432ce.zh: 以前这里的接线员要背下几千个号码，还会说好几种方言！
w5-d-87e432ce.en: The operators here knew thousands of numbers by heart — in several dialects!

w5-d-df1e6454.zh: 1949 年大家能自己拨号了，电话局就关门了。
w5-d-df1e6454.en: In 1949, when people could dial for themselves, the exchange closed.

w5-d-10b28975.zh: 听说唐人街那座宝塔屋顶的老房子门口，每天会响一次电话。
w5-d-10b28975.en: They say a phone rings once a day by the pagoda-roofed house in Chinatown.

w5-d-b8e9f992.zh: 据说美国最早的幸运饼干，1900 年代初就在这座茶园端上了桌。
w5-d-b8e9f992.en: They say America’s first fortune cookies were served in this tea garden in the early 1900s.

w5-d-ba16fae8.zh: 这家小饼干铺 1962 年就在这条小巷里开张了。
w5-d-ba16fae8.en: This little cookie bakery opened in this alley in 1962.

w5-d-73f4103a.zh: 听说日本茶园和唐人街的小巷里，每天都有一块新的幸运饼干。
w5-d-73f4103a.en: They say the Tea Garden and a Chinatown alley each keep a fresh fortune cookie every day.

w5-d-5a8b9ca6.zh: 1872 年，诺顿"皇帝"下令修一座跨湾大桥——64 年后真修好了！
w5-d-5a8b9ca6.en: In 1872 “Emperor” Norton decreed a bridge across the Bay — 64 years later, it opened!

w5-d-742c6056.zh: 听说海湾大桥脚下的灯柱上，卷着一张"圣旨"。
w5-d-742c6056.en: They say a rolled-up “decree” hangs on a lamppost by the Bay Bridge.

w5-d-247a8668.zh: 把耳朵凑近管口听听——涨潮的时候，它唱得最响！
w5-d-247a8668.en: Put your ear to a pipe — it sings loudest at high tide!

w5-d-9ff90ad8.zh: 听说码头区防波堤的尽头，把耳朵贴近管口能听见海在唱歌。
w5-d-9ff90ad8.en: They say that at the end of the Marina jetty, the sea sings into the pipes.

w5-d-9be8108a.zh: 1924 年，一架飞机天亮从纽约起飞，据说天黑前一分钟落在这里！
w5-d-9be8108a.en: In 1924 a plane left New York at dawn and landed here, reportedly a minute before dusk!

w5-d-c008ffa9.zh: 听说有人黄昏时骑鹈鹕降落在克里西场的草坪上，会有惊喜。
w5-d-c008ffa9.en: They say landing the pelican on the Crissy Field lawn at dusk brings a surprise.

w5-d-47270cef.zh: 很久以前，旧金山湾里也住着海獭——是我的远房亲戚！
w5-d-47270cef.en: Long ago, sea otters lived in San Francisco Bay too — my distant cousins!

w5-d-9f79ceb2.zh: 后来它们被猎皮毛的人抓得越来越少，现在还没回到湾里。
w5-d-9f79ceb2.en: Fur hunters took most of them, and they haven’t come back to the Bay yet.

w5-d-ce713c3e.zh: 听说 BAYBAY 一到大桥下的炮台水边，就会想起她的亲戚。
w5-d-ce713c3e.en: They say BAYBAY remembers her family at the water by the fort under the bridge.

w5-d-1aaa6e21.zh: 1953 年修房子时，电工在楼梯边找到一个 1861 年的铁盒！
w5-d-1aaa6e21.en: In 1953 an electrician found an 1861 tin by the stairs!

w5-d-b23e71ca.zh: 听说牛谷那座八角形的老房子旁边，藏着一个小铁盒。
w5-d-b23e71ca.en: They say a little tin is tucked by the eight-sided house in Cow Hollow.

w5-d-144e9f4b.zh: "Alcatraz"一般认为来自老西班牙语的"鹈鹕"——你飞回老家啦！
w5-d-144e9f4b.en: “Alcatraz” is usually traced to old Spanish for “pelican” — you’re flying home!

w5-d-16100fb3.zh: 水塔上的字，是 1969 到 1971 年原住民占领这座岛时写的。
w5-d-16100fb3.en: The words on the water tower date from the Native American occupation of 1969–71.

w5-d-0468b8c3.zh: 听说骑鹈鹕绕着湾里那座小岛飞一整圈，会有朋友来陪你。
w5-d-0468b8c3.en: They say if you fly the pelican right round the island in the Bay, friends join you.

w5-d-60ebb7cc.zh: 听！"呜——"一长声是南塔，"呜、呜"两声一组的在桥中间。
w5-d-60ebb7cc.en: Hear that? The long low one is the south tower; the double one is mid-span.

w5-d-a6ed2a6a.zh: 起雾挡住船的视线时，大桥的工作人员会亲手打开雾笛。
w5-d-a6ed2a6a.en: When fog hides the water from ships, bridge workers switch the horns on by hand.

w5-d-9c58fc8e.zh: 听说起雾的时候站在金门大桥上，能听见两种不一样的雾笛。
w5-d-9c58fc8e.en: They say that on the Golden Gate Bridge in fog you can hear two different foghorns.

w5-d-20290b00.zh: 是座头鲸！2016 年起它们常游进湾里觅食，看缘分哦。
w5-d-20290b00.en: A humpback! Since 2016 they often come into the Bay to feed — if you’re lucky.

w5-d-0de8ed95.zh: 听说春天到秋天，金门海峡里偶尔能看见座头鲸喷水。
w5-d-0de8ed95.en: They say that from spring to autumn a humpback sometimes spouts in the Golden Gate.

w5-d-7de0bbe6.zh: 这个石头迷宫被弄乱过好几次，每次都有人把它重新摆好。
w5-d-7de0bbe6.en: This stone labyrinth has been scattered many times — and someone always rebuilds it.

w5-d-fb5f231e.zh: 据说以前华人渔民在这个小湾停船扎营，所以叫"中国海滩"。
w5-d-fb5f231e.en: They say Chinese fishermen once anchored and camped in this cove — hence China Beach.

w5-d-1beb7579.zh: 听说海崖区那个小海湾，傍晚的海面上会出现旧时的帆影。
w5-d-1beb7579.en: They say old sails appear on the water of the Sea Cliff cove at golden hour.

w5-d-7a37cd95.zh: 大丽花是旧金山的市花，2026 年正好满一百年！
w5-d-7a37cd95.en: The dahlia is San Francisco’s official flower — 100 years in 2026!

w5-d-6ed84266.zh: 听说花卉温室东边的大丽花圃，今年有个特别的生日。
w5-d-6ed84266.en: They say the dahlia bed east of the Conservatory has a special birthday this year.

w5-d-c3e82677.zh: 从海底一路爬到星空——163 级台阶全是马赛克！
w5-d-c3e82677.en: From the sea floor up to the stars — 163 steps of mosaic!

w5-d-208bfdc7.zh: Karl 这个名字，是 2010 年一个社交账号带火的。
w5-d-208bfdc7.en: The name Karl caught on from a social account started in 2010.

w5-d-7b262fb5.zh: 九月通常是旧金山最暖和的月份，Karl 常常请假。
w5-d-7b262fb5.en: September is usually San Francisco’s warmest month — Karl often takes time off.

w5-d-598476b6.zh: "最冷的冬天是旧金山的夏天"？其实马克·吐温没说过。
w5-d-598476b6.en: “The coldest winter I ever spent was a summer in San Francisco”? Twain never said it.

w5-d-2729fa4a.zh: 听说起雾时站在双峰顶上，能看见 Karl 的小秘密。
w5-d-2729fa4a.en: They say Twin Peaks in fog shows you a secret or two about Karl.

w5-d-d184429b.zh: 日晷的影子，指着旧金山现在的真实时间！
w5-d-d184429b.en: The sundial’s shadow shows the real time in San Francisco right now!

w5-d-a39e01b9.zh: 1913 年 10 月 10 日它揭幕那天，巴拿马运河也接通了两大洋。
w5-d-a39e01b9.en: It opened on 10 Oct 1913 — the day the Panama Canal first joined the two oceans.

w5-d-be0f1a2c.zh: 听说英格塞德那座大日晷的影子，跟着真的太阳走。
w5-d-be0f1a2c.en: They say the Ingleside sundial’s shadow follows the real sun.

w5-d-a79e2ffc.zh: 1906 年大火时，消防员靠这个消防栓挡住了火，救下了教会区！
w5-d-a79e2ffc.en: In the 1906 fire, firefighters used this hydrant to stop the flames reaching the Mission!

w5-d-4be8cc60.zh: 每年 4 月 18 日一大早，大家会给它刷一层新金漆。
w5-d-4be8cc60.en: Every 18 April, early in the morning, people give it a fresh coat of gold.

w5-d-a939ff8e.zh: 听说多洛雷斯公园坡顶有个金色的消防栓，救过整个教会区。
w5-d-a939ff8e.en: They say a golden hydrant at the top of Dolores Park once saved the Mission.

w5-d-16090099.zh: 2014 年，这个路口铺上了彩虹斑马线！
w5-d-16090099.en: This crossing got its rainbow crosswalks in 2014!

w5-d-6a4da1dd.zh: 人行道上的铜牌，纪念为世界做出贡献的 LGBTQ 人士。
w5-d-6a4da1dd.en: The bronze plaques in the sidewalk honour LGBTQ people who made a difference.

w5-d-e3316b9e.zh: 听说走过卡斯特罗街口的彩虹斑马线，脚印会变成彩色的。
w5-d-e3316b9e.en: They say your footprints turn rainbow after the Castro’s rainbow crosswalk.

w5-d-a0b0c86e.zh: 从天上看，这座公园真的像一只大蓝鹭的脑袋！
w5-d-a0b0c86e.en: From up here the park really looks like a great blue heron’s head!

w5-d-9f43b811.zh: 听说从天上看湾景区海边那个公园，形状特别有意思。
w5-d-9f43b811.en: They say a park on the Bayview shore has a funny shape from the sky.

w5-d-ce06690d.zh: 1776 年 9 月 17 日，西班牙人在这里建起了要塞。
w5-d-ce06690d.en: On 17 September 1776 the Spanish founded the presidio here.

w5-d-0f94adfd.zh: 在那之前的几千年，这里一直是拉迈图什奥隆尼人的家园。
w5-d-0f94adfd.en: For thousands of years before that, this was Ramaytush Ohlone land.

w5-d-62c5c13a.zh: 1776 年，安萨的探险队在这附近扎营，为要塞找地方。
w5-d-62c5c13a.en: In 1776 Anza’s expedition camped near here, scouting a site for the fort.

w5-d-a4a1fc2c.zh: 多洛雷斯教堂是旧金山最古老的完整建筑。
w5-d-a4a1fc2c.en: Mission Dolores is the oldest intact building in San Francisco.

w5-d-165e1d1e.zh: 听说要塞、山湖和多洛雷斯教堂，藏着同一个 1776 年的故事。
w5-d-165e1d1e.en: They say the Presidio, Mountain Lake and Mission Dolores share one story from 1776.

w5-d-a5284561.zh: 别开下去！1972 年一场电影飞车把台阶磕坏了，印子还在呢。
w5-d-a5284561.en: Not down the steps! A 1972 movie chase chipped them, and the marks are still there.

w5-d-589706ce.zh: 听说太平洋高地公园的大台阶上，还留着一场老电影的印子。
w5-d-589706ce.en: They say the grand steps of Alta Plaza still carry marks from an old movie.

w5c-pelican-ask.zh: 以后想去哪都能飞啦！先试试起飞？
w5c-pelican-ask.en: Now we can fly anywhere! Want to try a take-off?

w5c-pelican-go.en: Hold on tight — here we go!

w5c-pelican-tour.zh: 送你一位鹈鹕朋友！以后想去哪都能飞～
w5c-pelican-tour.en: Meet your pelican friend — now we can fly anywhere!

w5c-pelican-nudge.zh: 先去科伊特塔找鹈鹕朋友吧！之后想去哪都能飞～
w5c-pelican-nudge.en: Let's meet the pelican at Coit Tower first — then we can fly anywhere!

w5c-welcome-back.zh: 欢迎回来！我们接着逛吧。

w5c-free-again.zh: 好嘞，你带路，我跟着！想去哪儿就叫我～
w5c-free-again.en: Okay — you lead, I'll follow! Call me when you want to go somewhere.

w5c-goals-intro.zh: 好嘞，整座旧金山都给你逛！先看看这几个小目标～
w5c-goals-intro.en: All of San Francisco is yours! Here are a few little goals~

w5c-deck-south.zh: 南塔到啦！走到北塔，就算走过金门大桥～
w5c-deck-south.en: The south tower! Walk on to the north tower to cross the bridge.

w5c-deck-north.zh: 北塔到啦！走到南塔，就算走过金门大桥～
w5c-deck-north.en: The north tower! Walk on to the south tower to cross the bridge.

w5c-deck-half.zh: 走到一半啦！脚下就是金门海峡。
w5c-deck-half.en: Halfway! Right below us is the Golden Gate strait.

w5c-deck-done.zh: 走过金门大桥啦！两座塔之间有 1280 米！
w5c-deck-done.en: We crossed the Golden Gate Bridge — 1,280 m from tower to tower!

w5-a-68e52b72.zh: 随便摇！越有爵士味越好～
w5-a-68e52b72.en: Ring anything! The jazzier the better!

w5-a-8310bdff.zh: 旧金山真有缆车摇铃比赛，司机们比谁摇得好听！
w5-a-8310bdff.en: SF really holds a cable-car bell contest for the crews!

w5-a-0eeb77ec.zh: 抓稳扶杆——咔嚓！经典缆车照！
w5-a-0eeb77ec.en: Hold the pole — snap! The classic cable-car shot!

w5-a-9673fffe.zh: 规定大人要有小朋友陪——BAYBAY 算小朋友吧？
w5-a-9673fffe.en: Rule: grown-ups need a kid along. Does BAYBAY count?

w5-a-3a877d76.en: You win! Lying back really is faster!

w5-a-ca17c4b5.zh: 我先到啦！下次按住躺下试试～
w5-a-ca17c4b5.en: Me first! Hold to lie back next time!

w5-a-04dffb06.zh: 真的去滑要自带纸板，穿结实的裤子哦！
w5-a-04dffb06.en: At the real slides, bring cardboard and sturdy pants!

w5-a-faa36af3.zh: 菲尔伯特台阶大约 400 级，两边都是花园！
w5-a-faa36af3.en: The Filbert Steps: about 400 steps, gardens on both sides!

w5-a-c23193fb.zh: 这 163 级台阶贴了 2000 多块手工瓷砖！
w5-a-c23193fb.en: These 163 steps wear over 2,000 handmade tiles!

w5-a-b58e50e0.en: I'm at the top! Come on up!

w5-a-2d4bf6f4.zh: 滑梯！坐块纸板，一起滑下去？
w5-a-2d4bf6f4.en: Slides! Grab some cardboard and whoosh down?

w5-a-c658f613.zh: 比比谁先爬到顶？我可不会让你哦！
w5-a-c658f613.en: Race you to the top? I won't go easy!

w5-d-de4d92ae.zh: 看！Karl 从海那边漫过来了，苏特罗塔在前面站岗。
w5-d-de4d92ae.en: Look! Karl is rolling in from the sea, with Sutro Tower standing guard.

w5-d-f85309cd.zh: 夏天 Karl 来得最勤，七月通常最浓。
w5-d-f85309cd.en: Karl visits most in summer — July is usually the thickest.

w5-d-d363e789.zh: Karl 今天好像请假了……早上或傍晚再上来看看吧。
w5-d-d363e789.en: Looks like Karl took the day off… come back up in the morning or at dusk.

w5-d-17f0e16b.zh: 今天就是 4 月 18 日！看，有人在给它刷金漆。
w5-d-17f0e16b.en: It’s 18 April today! Look — someone’s giving it fresh gold paint.

w5-d-e34f1f03.zh: 大丽花通常六到十月开，现在花圃在休息。
w5-d-e34f1f03.en: Dahlias usually bloom June to October — the beds are resting now.
